scope: retrospective assessment only; no state selection, projection, PDE solve, physical-source change or renewed tuning
native_geometry_catalogue: typed immutable native CG rows on the already frozen common union of selected/confirmation panels, GL8; cross-model reuse only after both-model native value/gradient/stress/production replay
polynomial_reconstruction: affine cubic primitive fields and gradients; weighted Legendre reconstruction verified at source GL8 nodes; selected nonlinear stresses freshly evaluated at target points, never stress-interpolated
all_accepted_states: every unique native state including trial prefixes; actual binary64 state/history identities preserved
additional_volume_audit: GL28 on every common union panel and retained streamwise panel, fixed before assessment; exact native sided/interface and station checks remain complementary
freshness: initial native-element GL28 was consumed at checkpoint2; this is an independently evaluated denser all-state volume check, not a fresh selection gate; no tuning on its witnesses
hard_checks: positive finite k and actual outer epsilon/dependent inner epsilon; full selected covariance >=1e-4 K0; physical strong divergence RMS/(u_tau/H)<=1e-3
full_tensor_accuracy: R and mean T, all 3x3 entries, regional physical RMS by u_tau^2; report full scalar-gradient errors and actual production
comparisons: dt/halfdt, selected/confirmation and final-window L2 plus pointwise principal differences; absolute pressure, no gauge shift; independent GL8/12 constitutive quadrature confirmation
trend: least-squares slope on actual final-window states, scaled by one Treq for an accuracy-scale diagnostic; no infinite-time or future-state claim
budgets: same origin and aggregate ledger/envelope as checkpoint0; analysis and I/O time are measured; no additional physical attempts charged for read-only reconstruction
